features.behavior: Background pointer pan, wheel-centered/button/keyboard zoom, fit, resize fit

features.behavior: One inspector drawer: header/title/status/origin + four tabs/body + common footer
features.sourceEvidence: H4; A98–101; S1,5. Root aside is one flex column, right/full-height width min(720px,100vw), separate scrim, body scroll, fixed header/tabs/footer within it. features.behavior: Overview outcome, ownership/id/current baseline, counts/stage, dependencies/impact, release return
features.sourceEvidence: A102. Entity/release view read-only blueprint yet Link still adds live relationships.
A104,108. Trim/split lines; identical behavior save does not change revision; actual edit does. Other sections start collapsed/re-render resets disclosure state.

features.behavior: Rules browse/details + fixed safe spacing/progress demos
features.sourceEvidence: A103–104,114. Arbitrary expression never executed. Progress validates bounded integers; spacing fixed 8,1.618,4,64 constants.
A116. Lists unpinned ids, disabled if empty; pin changes selected draft and invalidates proof. Multiple versions of same key can be pinned. No unpin.
A128. Metadata, unique stable key, version1.0.0, pin selected draft, append event; no evaluator.

features.behavior: Rule revision + selected consuming draft/new consumer work
features.sourceEvidence: A115. Globally latest key version determines next patch; must exceed latest; append supersedes, replace only matching pin in selected draft; unchanged expression preserves preview tag. No consumer auto-upgrade.
A104,117. id/type/parent/token/event + local duplicate/self-parent rejection; declaration only, no actual source-wiring validation. No edit/remove or full hierarchy validation.
A104,108. Dedup paths, reject absolute /, '..' anywhere, backslash, colon; no canonical path/symlink/ownership enforcement. No actual file access.
A104,118. Changes blueprint revision, event; no editing/deleting.
A105,108. Every addition/toggle increments draft revision (including completing a task); no rename/remove/reorder.

features.behavior: Evidence attach: six categories, passed/failed, reference+note
features.sourceEvidence: A105,109. Manual assertion/current revision; stale retained; no CI/result fetching, proof edit/removal/supersession. Reference is escaped text, not external navigation.
A51–56,105,108. Review binds revision; evidence/review themselves do not increment draft revision.

A51–57,110–113. Nonempty/all tasks done; nonempty/all current proof pass/non-demo; current manual approval; every blocking target has a release. Unique greater semver per entity and required summary; atomically in-memory snapshot/baseline/card Done via change(). No stage-qa requirement or deployment.
A106–107. Compare eight blueprint fields, not code diff; latest35 relevant events. Does not compare stale source against current baseline.
A107,127. Confirm; hide execution but keep data; restore always Plan. No board archive filter/list; reachable from capability Delivery/journal. Archived drawer not editable but restore available.
A97,107. Newest append order; module filter can hide project-wide null-entity events; no edits/replay.
A119. identity/revision/origin/spec/tasks/UI/rules/decisions/files/dependency targetReleaseIds; explicitly unenforced/deny deployment; no agent/process launch.

features.behavior: Full project export vs separate journal export
features.sourceEvidence: A28,123,161–162. Blob download/object URL revoke; journal lacks full restoration records. No CSV/PDF/share/network.

features.behavior: Full v2 JSON replace import/file selection
features.sourceEvidence: A29–47,123,125,163,169. Max8MB, parse+validate before confirmation/replacement; clone incoming, append import event+increment project revision, reset scoped view. No merge.

A123–125,164. Separate old key preserved; one legacy module/entity per card, no releases/rules/proof/review; old Done→Review, dependencies demote Queue/Process→Plan, >2 Process→Queue; old history retained in import events.
A165–166. Explicit confirm warning before reset; clones seed, appends reset event; old project history discarded; reset does not increment seed revision. Reload is real location.reload.

features.behavior: Storage unavailable/invalid recovery and cross-tab pause
features.sourceEvidence: A9–10,22–26,171. Warning/export fallback; revision inequality only; no database/multi-agent transactional safety.

features.behavior: Modal/inspector close, scrim/outside click, Escape, focus trap/return, N and / shortcuts, toast
features.sourceEvidence: A99–101,120–121,168–170; H4. Tabs not ARIA tabs; modal lacks explicit accessible label; no unsaved-form dirty guard; no body scroll lock/inert background declaration. Focus return for modal less complete than inspector.

S1–6. Desktop sidebar→narrow nav at900px; horizontal board inside viewport at1200/600px; graph side moves under; journal aside hidden small; single full-width drawer at mobile; reduced-motion. Archive screenshot only, not independently rerendered.

acceptance.behavior: The requested drawer header/content/inspector is one mount, bounds and lifecycle unit.
One cohesive header and scoped drawer layout preserve host shell and fit compact/enlarged sizes.
Existing project selection and preview/editor/terminal owners survive integration; requests remain project-fenced.
Ownership and milestone/slice/AT execution are explicitly linked without duplicate status or invented authority.
Existing readiness/coverage is reconciled and source baseline frozen before implementation.
One reviewed schema/authority mapping with exact historical pins and task-bound execution facts.
Transactional, idempotent, durable, project-isolated API mutations with conflict/recovery checks.
Trusted source-bound evidence and review gates; manual/demo/stale proof never fabricates success.
Recorded scale/lifecycle budgets and measurements on representative fixtures.
Combined source/package/gate/browser acceptance and reversible promotion.
